user.title: Set up Plug Protection
user.description: Protect a smart plug from being turned off while an appliance is running.

data.raise_on_block: Report an error when a turn-off is blocked

data_description.plug_entity: The switch entity of the smart plug to protect.
data_description.power_sensor: Sensor reporting current power consumption in Watts.
data_description.power_threshold: Protection activates above this value. Typical: 5-10 W for washing machines, 15-30 W for 3D printers.
data_description.cooldown_seconds: After power drops below the threshold, protection stays active for this duration.
data_description.enable_notification: Display a persistent notification when a turn-off attempt is blocked.
data_description.raise_on_block: If on, turning the protected switch off while protected fails with an error (an automation stops at that action). If off, the command is silently ignored.

reconfigure.title: Change protected plug
reconfigure.description: Select a different plug or power sensor. Threshold and cooldown are changed under Configure.

init.title: Plug Protection settings
init.description: Adjust protection parameters. The integration reloads after saving; a running cooldown is kept.

data.raise_on_block: Report an error when a turn-off is blocked

data_description.raise_on_block: If on, turning the protected switch off while protected fails with an error (an automation stops at that action). If off, the command is silently ignored.

force_off.name: Force off
force_off.description: Turn off a protected plug, bypassing all protection. Use with caution – the plug is switched off regardless of power consumption or cooldown.

reset_cooldown.name: Reset cooldown
reset_cooldown.description: End a running cooldown immediately so the plug can be turned off normally.

turn_off_blocked.message: Turn-off of {name} was blocked: the appliance is running.

entity_missing.title: Plug Protection: entity not found
entity_missing.description:
The protection for "{name}" cannot work because these entities do not exist: {entities}.

If the plug or its power sensor was replaced, open Settings → Devices & services → Plug Protection and use **Reconfigure** to select the new entities.
